homepageDescription: Your journal, tasks, plans, files, and heatmap will come together here.
homepageSafeModeDescription: Homepage Studio is in read-only safe mode.
homepageBannerSubtitle: Personal knowledge workbench and digital archive
homepageArchiveBannerSubtitle: FIELD STATION // OBSERVATION DECK // DAILY LOG
homepageArchiveFooter: ARCHIVE TERMINAL // SESSION {date} // END OF RECORD
heatmapEmptyDescription: Heatmap data appears after you edit Markdown files in Obsidian.
heatmapCountTypeDescription: Switching between characters and words clears today's session and total to avoid mixed units.
heatmapDateRangeDescription: Show a recent number of days or one fixed year.
heatmapWeekStartDescription: Choose the first day of each heatmap week.
heatmapThresholdsDescription: Enter three strictly increasing positive integers separated by commas.
heatmapExcludeFoldersDescription: Enter one vault folder path per line. Filtering only changes days that still have file details.
heatmapRetentionDescription: Use 0 to keep details forever. Expired days keep totals but can no longer be recalculated by folder.
heatmapDayNoActivity: No added content matches the current filters for this date.
heatmapDayArchived: Only the total remains for this date; file details were archived.
journalEmptyDescription: Choose the single Markdown file that stores your journal.
journalViewModeDescription: Choose whether the homepage journal opens as Markdown source or rendered preview.
journalDateSectionFileDescription: Enter a vault Markdown path and choose from suggestions. Existing files are strictly validated; creation only makes an empty file.
journalSourceAlreadyExists: A file already exists at this path. Use “Use existing file” to validate it.
journalSourceInvalidPath: Enter a valid vault path ending in .md.
journalSourceIoError: The journal file could not be accessed. Check its path and permissions.
journalConfigurationUnavailable: Journal configuration cannot be changed while data is loading or read-only.
journalLoadingDescription: The configured date-section file is being validated.
journalMissingDescription: The path {path} is retained. The journal will recover when the file returns to the same location.
journalInvalidDescription: The file contains duplicate, out-of-order, or ambiguous date sections. The homepage remains read-only until it is repaired.
journalIoTitle: Journal file could not be read
journalIoDescription: Check file permissions or choose the source again in settings.
journalEmptyPreview: There is no journal content for this date.
journalConflictTitle: Journal draft conflicts with the source
journalConflictDescription: The local draft remains in the editor. Save it elsewhere before reloading the external version, or open the source file to resolve the conflict.
journalWriteMissing: Journal write failed because {path} is missing. The configured path was retained.
journalWriteInvalid: Journal write failed because the date-section structure in {path} is invalid. Repair the source file first.
journalWriteFuture: Journal write failed because future journal dates cannot be created.
journalWriteIo: Journal write failed because {path} could not be written. Check its permissions.
journalDeleteDescription: The date heading and body for {date} will be removed from {path}. The file itself will not be deleted.
tasksEmptyDescription: Choose the Markdown file that stores tasks for this homepage.
tasksMissingDescription: {path} could not be found. Restore it or choose another task file.
tasksInvalidDescription: The managed region is duplicated, out of order, or contains unsupported content.
tasksMissingRegionDescription: The task file does not contain a Homepage tasks managed region.
tasksIoTitle: Task file could not be read
tasksIoDescription: An error occurred while reading the task file. Check its permissions.
tasksFileDescription: Choose a Markdown file with a Homepage tasks managed region, or create a new task file.
tasksShowCompletedDescription: Show completed tasks that have not yet been archived in the active list.
tasksShowArchiveToggleDescription: Show the archive entry in the Homepage task module. Hiding it also hides the archived task list.
tasksRecurringDescription: Manage long-lived daily and weekly tasks. Tasks added on the homepage remain one-time tasks.
tasksRecurringCreateDescription: Choose a daily or weekly cycle, then add the task to Active.
tasksRecurringUnavailable: Configure a valid task source to manage recurring tasks.
tasksSourceInvalidUnknown: The task structure is invalid and no line details are available.
tasksSourceInvalidPath: Enter a valid Markdown path inside the vault.
tasksSourceIoError: Task file could not be accessed: {path}
tasksAppendCancelled: The existing file was not changed.
tasksAppendDescription: {path} does not contain a managed region. Confirm to append Homepage tasks, Active, and Archive headings while preserving all other content.
tasksDeleteDescription: Delete “{task}” from {path}? This changes the Markdown file.
tasksInvalidTask: Use one non-empty task line without Homepage Studio reserved fields.
tasksConflict: The task changed externally, so this edit was not written.
tasksConflictDescription: The operation was not written. Review the unsaved draft below, reload the external version, or open the task source to reconcile it.
tasksWriteFailed: Task file could not be written: {path}
currentPlanEmptyDescription: Create or select a daily or weekly plan template.
planModeDescription: Switch between a repeating daily schedule and a seven-day weekly schedule. Each mode remembers its selected template.
planDailyTemplatesDescription: Create reusable schedules. Gaps are shown as free time and overlapping periods cannot be saved.
planWeeklyTemplatesDescription: Configure Monday through Sunday separately. A period may cross midnight once and remains attached to its starting day.
planSelectedTemplateDescription: Choose the daily schedule shown on the homepage.
planSelectedWeeklyTemplateDescription: Choose the weekly schedule shown on the homepage.
planNoPeriods: No periods yet. The whole day will be shown as free time.
planInvalidName: Enter a template name between 1 and 100 characters.
planInvalidLabel: Enter a task name between 1 and 200 characters.
planInvalidStartTime: Enter a valid start time between 0:00 and 23:59.
planInvalidEndTime: Enter a valid end time between 0:00 and 24:00.
planInvalidPeriod: A period cannot exceed 24 hours or cross midnight more than once.
planOverlap: This period overlaps another period on the same day.
planOvernightOverlap: This period overlaps a period that crosses midnight. Check both the starting day and the following day.
planTemplateNotFound: That plan template is no longer available.
planSettingsUnavailable: Plan settings cannot be edited right now. Reload and try again.
planDeleteDescription: Delete “{name}” and all of its schedule periods?
planDeleteSelectedDescription: This is the active template. Deleting it will leave the current plan unconfigured; another template will not be selected automatically.
bannerGlobalSourceDescription: Used by themes that inherit the global Banner source. If no custom source is configured, each theme uses its offline default Banner.
bannerVaultSourceDescription: Choose a supported image file from this vault.
bannerRemotePrivacyDescription: Loading a remote image sends a normal network request directly to its server. The server may observe your IP address, request time, and other standard request metadata. Homepage Studio does not download or permanently cache the image.
bannerThemeConfigurationDescription: Choose a theme to configure its source inheritance, height, and focal point.
bannerMinimalPaperDisabledDescription: Minimal paper intentionally omits Banner to preserve its paper-first layout, so Banner visibility, source, height, and focal point settings are hidden for this theme.
bannerHeightDescription: Choose a compact, standard, or tall Banner height for this theme.
bannerFocalPointDescription: Horizontal and vertical percentages keep the important part of a custom image visible as the homepage narrows.
bannerInvalidFile: Choose an existing supported vault image.
bannerInvalidProtocol: Only HTTP and HTTPS image URLs are supported.
bannerInvalidPosition: Enter focal point values from 0 through 100.
bannerUnavailable: Banner configuration is unavailable while plugin data is read-only.
layoutThemeDescription: Switch the homepage theme. Each theme stores its own layout.
layoutAppearanceDescription: Follow Obsidian or use a fixed light or dark appearance.
layoutModulesDescription: Drag module headings to reorder them, or use the move up and move down buttons. Sizes are semantic presets mapped by the theme.
layoutBannerVisibleDescription: The Banner is independent of module ordering, and its visibility does not depend on the height preset.
layoutRestoreDefaultDescription: Clear only the current theme layout override without changing module content or other themes.
layoutUnavailable: Layout editing is unavailable while plugin data is read-only.
layoutResetTitle: Restore the current theme default layout?
layoutResetDescription: Clear the module visibility, order, size, and Banner visibility overrides for “{theme}”. Module content and other themes will not change.
fileGroupsEmptyDescription: Create a group and add vault files for quick access.
fileGroupsGroupEmpty: No files have been added to this group.
fileGroupsCreateDescription: Create a named group, then choose the vault files to show in it.
fileGroupsSettingsEmpty: No file groups have been created.
fileGroupsAddFileDescription: Enter a path and choose any vault file from Obsidian suggestions. Folders are not supported.
fileGroupsReorderFile: Reorder {path}. Use Alt with arrow, Home, or End keys.
fileGroupsReplaceFileDescription: Choose an existing vault file to replace this unavailable path.
fileGroupsUndoDescription: Removed “{path}”. The vault file was not deleted.
fileGroupsNoFiles: No files have been added to this group.
fileGroupsInvalidName: Enter a group name between 1 and 100 characters.
fileGroupsInvalidFile: Choose an existing vault file. Folders cannot be added.
fileGroupsDuplicateFile: That file is already in this group.
fileGroupsNotFound: That file group or entry is no longer available.
fileGroupsUnavailable: File group settings cannot be edited right now. Reload and try again.
fileGroupsDeleteDescription: Delete “{name}” and its {count} file entries? No vault files will be deleted.
diagnosticDuplicateHomepage: Homepage Studio repaired duplicate homepage views.
diagnosticReloadWorkspace: Reload the workspace if the duplicate view returns.
diagnosticRepairData: Repair data.json and reload the plugin, or reset after creating a backup.
persistenceWriteFailed: Homepage Studio could not save data
persistenceWriteRecoveryAction: Your latest changes remain in memory. Check storage space and permissions; Homepage Studio will retry while the plugin remains enabled.
resetBackupRecoveryAction: No reset was performed. Check storage space and permissions, then run the reset again.
backupFailed: Homepage Studio could not back up data
resetDataDescription: A timestamped backup of the existing data will be created before the reset. This replaces all Homepage Studio settings.
resetDataFinalTitle: Permanently replace all Homepage Studio data?
resetDataFinalDescription: This is the final confirmation. Homepage Studio will first create a timestamped backup, then replace every plugin setting, layout, task reference, plan template, file group, Banner preference, and Heatmap record.
dataManagementPlatformDescription: Homepage Studio supports Obsidian desktop on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Mobile devices are not supported.
dataManagementPrivacyDescription: A remote Banner is requested directly from its server, which may observe your IP address, request time, and standard request metadata. Homepage Studio does not permanently cache the image.
dataManagementDiagnosticsDescription: Copy the localized report when troubleshooting data.json. Safe mode is read-only and does not update Heatmap records or other plugin data.
dataManagementReloadDescription: After repairing data.json outside Obsidian, reload it here. Reloading does not modify the file.
dataManagementBackupDescription: Before the first write in a session, the previous valid file is copied to data.backup.json. Schema migrations and full resets use timestamped backups.
dataManagementResetDescription: Full reset requires two confirmations. If the timestamped backup cannot be created, the reset is stopped and the existing file remains active.
interfaceLanguageDescription: Choose a language or follow Obsidian.
bannerTitleSettingDescription: Customize the title in the lower-left corner of the Banner. Clear it to hide the title.
bannerSubtitleSettingDescription: Customize the subtitle in the lower-left corner of the Banner. Clear it to hide the subtitle.
openOnStartupDescription: Open Homepage Studio after the workspace has been restored.
openWhenWorkspaceEmpty: Open when the workspace is empty
openWhenWorkspaceEmptyDescription: Open Homepage Studio when no other central content page remains.
